title: searchSDK benchmark protocol

tracks.task: Normalized ranked web results; SDK adapter defaults, result ceiling 10, no generated answers, ingestion, or implicit pagination.

tracks.nonComparableReason: WonderSearch retrieves from a configured corpus. A frozen public or permissioned corpus, access rules, ingestion state, and corpus-specific judgments are required. It cannot share an open-web leaderboard. No corpus ingestion or native mutation is performed.

dataset.provenance: Original public-domain prompts about public documentation, science, and reference topics. No personal data, production queries, or account identifiers.
dataset.limitation: Smoke dataset only; too small and narrow for general provider rankings. Relevance judgments are not yet collected.

safety.fixtureMode: injected synthetic responses; no provider calls or credentials
liveOptIn: validated runtime, provider plan, pricing date, per-request reservation and total budget
safety.secrets: Environment only. Never serialized: environment values, headers, full URLs, result content, raw exceptions, account identifiers, or private hostnames.
safety.budget: Warmups, errors and timeouts consume the same request and conservative cost-reservation budgets. No retries. Reservations are operator-verified bounds, not actual charges or a guarantee of remote billing. Reconcile provider usage before publication.

requiredEvidence: query-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence intervals with published seed and resamples

metrics.measure: nearest-rank p50 and p95 milliseconds for schema-valid measured responses
requiredEvidence: all error and timeout durations retained separately

metrics.measure: schema-valid responses / all started measured attempts
requiredEvidence: rate limits, auth, provider errors and timeouts separately
unstarted requests excluded from denominator and disclosed

fairness: Seeded query and provider order, interleaved per query and repeated in three rounds
Same public prompts, result ceiling, timeouts and serial dispatch policy
Publish provider API revision, exact adapter profile, plan, source/build hash and exceptions
Provider defaults may differ in retrieval depth, content work, geography and index; no assertion of identical native work
SearXNG depends on an operator-selected instance and upstream engines; use a public alias and a separately approved sanitized engine manifest
Do not equate process warmup with controlled cold or warm provider caches
Never compare provider-native relevance scores directly
Publish failures, exclusions, sample sizes, conflicts of interest and limitations
requiredRunMetadata: provider API version and adapter profile

artifacts.results: results.json with summaries, exclusions, null relevance and unreconciled cost
artifacts.publication: All outputs are unreviewed, publicationReady=false. Public fixtures must stay labelled synthetic. No automatic website leaderboard or upload.

publicationPolicy: No invented scores or fixture timings presented as provider performance
No ranking before representative dataset, independent judgments and reproducible reviewed run artifacts
Publish lawful sanitized evidence only; keep secrets and private instance details out
Record exclusions and incomplete runs; never drop failed providers silently
Recheck current Boat and provider documentation before any future live execution
